keep.quote: A 2011 talk said you may be lied to 10 to 200 times a day (c12).
In one US survey, most people reported no lies at all that day, and almost half of all the lies came from about 5% of people (c03, c04).
Untrained, people tell a lie from the truth about 54% of the time (c06). A coin flip that leans toward believing.
